name: vps-audit
description: lightweight, dependency-free bash script for security, performance auditing and infrastructure monitoring of Linux servers.
readme_summary: vps-audit is a lightweight, dependency-free Bash script designed for comprehensive security and performance auditing of Linux servers. It checks SSH configuration, firewall status, intrusion prevention, system updates, running services, open ports, and more, providing real-time feedback and detailed reports with actionable recommendations.
key_features: Comprehensive security checks (SSH, Firewall, Fail2ban/CrowdSec, Failed Logins, System Updates, Running Services, Open Ports, Sudo Logging, Password Policy, SUID Files)
Performance monitoring (Disk Space, Memory, CPU Usage, Active Internet Connections)
Lightweight and dependency-free Bash script
Real-time console output with color-coded status (PASS, WARN, FAIL)
Detailed audit report generation with recommendations
Customizable thresholds for PASS/WARN/FAIL statuses
Supports Ubuntu/Debian-based systems
primary_use_case: Auditing the security and performance of Linux Virtual Private Servers (VPS) to identify vulnerabilities and areas for improvement.
cover_image_prompt: A vigilant digital guardian, represented as a stylized shield with glowing circuits, meticulously inspecting a blueprint of a server rack. The guardian's gaze highlights potential weak points with red markers, while confirming secure areas with green checkmarks. Subtle data streams flow around the scene, representing system performance metrics like CPU and memory usage. In the background, a stylized cityscape represents the internet, with the server blueprint acting as a secure fortress. The overall mood is one of proactive security and system health. The art style is a clean, modern 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clear iconography and a cool, professional color palette.

name: avoid-ai-writing
description: Skill that audits and rewrites content to remove AI writing patterns. Use it with your favorite agents including Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, and Hermes.
readme_summary: This JavaScript skill audits and rewrites content to remove common AI writing patterns, making text sound more human. It supports multiple modes like detection-only, full rewrite, and in-place editing, along with customizable voice profiles.
key_features: Audits and rewrites content to remove AI writing patterns
Supports detect-only and edit-in-place modes
Includes optional voice profiles (casual, professional, technical, warm, blunt)
Provides a structured audit with identified issues, rewrites, and change summaries
Features a two-pass detection system for thorough analysis
Utilizes a comprehensive word replacement table with tiered flagging
primary_use_case: To enhance the human-like quality of AI-generated text by identifying and correcting AI writing patterns, making content more natural and less detectable as machine-generated.
cover_image_prompt: A meticulous scribe sitting at an old wooden desk, holding a quill pen that glows with a subtle digital aura. Before the scribe is a stack of papers filled with generic, repetitive text, emanating a faint, sterile blue light. The scribe is actively transforming this text into a new document that flows with vibrant, natural handwriting, emitting a warm, golden glow. Small, almost invisible digital particles representing 'AI-isms' are being swept away by the quill's magic. In the background, a subtle, minimalist UI element displays 'AI Pattern Detected' and 'Humanized Text Score'. The scene is lit with a soft, focused light, emphasizing the transformation. Rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a clean, uncluttered composition and a warm, inviting color palette.

name: zedis
description: Zedis: A blazing-fast, native Redis GUI built with Rust and GPUI.
readme_summary: Zedis is a high-performance, native GUI client for Redis, built with Rust and GPUI. It offers a smooth, GPU-accelerated user experience with minimal memory usage, designed to handle large databases efficiently.
key_features: Native, GPU-accelerated rendering with Rust and GPUI
Efficient handling of millions of keys with virtual scrolling and low memory footprint
Intelligent data viewers for various Redis types and formats (JSON, Protobuf, MessagePack, images, hex)
Real-time observability features including live metrics, memory analysis, and hot-key tracking
Secure connection options including TLS/SSL and SSH tunnels
Import capabilities from other Redis clients (Redis Insight, ARDM, Tiny RDM)
Power-user features like a command palette, redis-cli integration with AI assistance, and batch operations
primary_use_case: Providing developers with a fast, efficient, and feature-rich graphical interface for interacting with and managing Redis databases, especially those with large datasets.
cover_image_prompt: A powerful, sleek, and futuristic locomotive engine, labeled 'Zedis', effortlessly pulling an incredibly long train of glowing data cubes through a vast, dark landscape. The engine's front is a stylized GPU chip emitting vibrant light, symbolizing its native, GPU-accelerated power. The train cars are virtual-scrolled, showing millions of keys represented as tiny, organized blocks. In the background, subtle, abstract representations of Redis data structures like JSON, Protobuf, and images are visible. The overall mood is one of speed, efficiency, and control over massive data. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a dark, high-tech color palette and glowing accents.
